document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Five-foot-long crustacean things! With pincers and claws, they 
clutch mechanical devices. Their activities stop as the startled 
creatures turn off their machines—and reach for other devices 
near at hand.

The screams of terror from your party form a chorus behind 
you. They don’t need your leadership to know what to do—
they flee from the alien conclave as swiftly as their legs will 
carry them.
Gain 2 points of Cthulhu Mythos. Go to 143.
